description: Marks one cleaner as preferred, blocked or backup for a client, as the contact card's relationship chips do. Give staff_id (read entity staff_profiles) or a staff_name; a name that matches exactly one person is keyed by that person's id, so a rename replaces the same row. strength 1-10 (default 7 for preferred, 5 otherwise) and reason are optional. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; it is one row per person, so a repeat updates the same row.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: save_client_staff_relationship
title: Mark a cleaner preferred, blocked or backup for a client
